name: Shortcodes
description: Type : and a name for an emoji or an icon, as in Slack or Discord: :fi suggests 🔥, and :fire: typed whole becomes it. Icons go in as :LiCalendar:, Obsidian's Iconize way, and show as the icon.

emoji.label: Emoji
emoji.description: suggested after a colon; and `:fire:` turns into 🔥

icons.label: Icons
icons.description: the app's icons too, like `:icon-calendar`; and `:LiCalendar:` shows as the icon
